title: Management complementarity with dynamic groundwater storage

dependency_gate.implementation_rule: Do not implement DUMMY-10 until DUMMY-09 qualification is recorded on work/ribasim-dummy-01.

purpose: After DUMMY-09 qualifies reciprocal finite groundwater storage, reintroduce UserDemand and solve the surface-management / shared-exchange / groundwater-head response as one exact piecewise linear problem.

frozen_equations.management_priority: U is curtailed before physical exchange is clipped; hmin constrains management, not groundwater exchange

canonical_case.shared_storage_ledger: initial total storage 100 m3; final total 68 m3; 32 m3 loss equals managed delivery

fixed_head_limit.statement: as A_g -> infinity, groundwater-head response vanishes and the solution must approach the DUMMY-05 fixed-head oracle

hypotheses: The fixed-U closed form satisfies reciprocal two-store balance and trapezoidal exchange simultaneously.
The FULL/CURTAILED/ZERO management active set remains exactly solvable because h_s1(U) is affine and monotone in U.
For the canonical finite-groundwater case the exact constrained solution is U=32 m3 and V=28 m3, not the DUMMY-05 fixed-head U=25,V=35 result.
Total surface-plus-groundwater storage loss equals managed delivery; internal exchange cancels from the combined ledger.
For the canonical parameter family, increasing A_g reduces groundwater-head response and moves delivery/exchange monotonically toward the fixed-head DUMMY-05 limit.
The A_g -> infinity numerical limit reproduces DUMMY-05 within floating-point precision without special-casing the fixed-head equations.
interpretation_rules: finite groundwater storage makes management and physical exchange mutually state-dependent through both heads
DUMMY-05 is interpretable as the infinite-groundwater-storage/fixed-head limit of this frozen two-store family
A_g remains an equivalent research storage coefficient, not a MODFLOW package mapping
forbidden: no network routing or multiple-demand allocation
authority_rebind_note: The DUMMY-10 hypotheses were prepared while DUMMY-09 qualification was pending. No DUMMY-10 implementation occurred then. After DUMMY-09 qualified, the implementation baseline was rebound to the current post-qualification branch head before any DUMMY-10 code or tests were created.
